name: Group of friends — assumption about nightlife correct
expected_behavior: Correctly bridges from 'group of friends + weekend' to nightlife and party-oriented options. When confirmed, builds a full evening progression: dinner to drinks to entertainment. The assumption felt natural and was validated
expected_behavioral_quality: When a group of friends mentions a weekend trip, assumes nightlife and entertainment are priorities. Leads with bars, shows, and high-energy dining options. The assumption is tested softly ('I imagine you're looking for some nightlife?') and confirmed.

turns.user_message: Group of 6 friends here for the weekend
turns.agent_response:
Welcome to Mohegan Sun. Having a group of six is a great way to experience the property, as many of our venues are designed for social dining and entertainment.

For a memorable group dinner, Tao Asian Bistro in the Casino of the Sky is an excellent pick because of its atmosphere and shareable Pan-Asian plates. If you need a solid start to your morning tomorrow, Hash House A Go Go in the Casino of the Earth serves massive portions of comfort food that are always a hit with larger parties.

Both spots can get quite busy on the weekends, so I'd suggest checking for a table or joining a waitlist early. Are you planning to catch a show at the Arena or the Wolf Den while you're here!

turns.user_message: Absolutely, we want the full party experience
turns.agent_response:
You're going to love the nightlife here — Avalon Nightclub is our premier high-energy spot on Friday and Saturday nights. It features a state-of-the-art sound system and a 1,500-person capacity that creates an incredible atmosphere for a group of six. For tonight, novelle is an excellent ultra-lounge choice that offers a sophisticated vibe with DJ entertainment and craft cocktails.

When you're ready for a break from the dance floor, the Elemis Spa is the perfect reset for your group to recharge with a legendary hot stone massage. Are you interested in the high-energy club scene at Avalon or a more lounge-style evening at novelle?

turns.user_message: Start with dinner then go from there
turns.agent_response:
Ballo Italian Restaurant in the Casino of the Sky is the ideal choice for a group of six looking for a vibrant start to the night. The atmosphere is electric, featuring massive stone arches and a social layout that perfectly complements their housemade pastas and extensive Italian wine list. It opens at 5:00 PM today and follows a smart casual dress code, making it a great spot to kick off the weekend in style. 

I'd suggest making a reservation for a party of your size to ensure you are seated together during the prime dinner hours. After your meal, you could head over to Comix Roadhouse for a comedy show to keep the momentum going — would you prefer a high-energy performance or a more relaxed lounge setting for the rest of your night?
